# Pauli Learning Memory Thresholds

Scientific question: acquire a reusable record before a Pauli target is
specified, supporting every coefficient through weight w of an unknown
n-qubit Pauli channel. At each invocation, at most k other coherent qubits
may be present. Every channel call is charged.

Sister project: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Learning-Without-Resets.
The original width frontier here permits resets, fresh probes and classical
history. The common no-reset weight-one task at retained coefficient 1/2
requires linear initial negentropy for any finite query count. Read
science/no_reset_frontier.md for the exact common model and consequences;
the authoritative full shared entropy proof is
https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Quantum-Learning-Without-Resets/blob/892a1702e80ea1a8a56ac93b81bc0d7273a8f1ec/science/entropy_bound.md.

Start with README.md and science/model.md; learning/WORKED_EXAMPLE.md gives
a concrete two-qubit experiment. Pauli weight counts nonidentity tensor
factors. Write D=n-k and R=wD/n. At fixed nontrivial accuracy and confidence,
polynomial query complexity is possible exactly when R=O(log n), even with
arbitrary coherent reuse. The converse needs only pointwise success for each
late target; the construction gives simultaneous success for the whole family.

Learning route:
- learning/MILESTONES.md: exactly 30 learner-independent understanding targets;
  M01-M14 assemble the background and model, and M15-M30 explain the narrative,
  results, physical meaning, attribution, and limits. Each entry gives its
  question, target, earlier dependencies, conceptual connection, and sources.
- learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md: the single educational anchor, John Watrous's
  The Theory of Quantum Information (2018), with precise section pointers,
  convention translations, resource assumptions, and source-to-project steps.
- learning/WORKED_EXAMPLE.md: two channel qubits and one reference, including
  the physical settings, reusable estimator, exact syndrome parity, and finite
  detector call counts at two known noise strengths.

Authoritative scientific homes:
- science/model.md: Pauli channels, total coherent width at each invocation,
  late-index learning, output contract, one-bit promise, and resource accounting.
- science/weighted_bounds.md: product prior, normalized Schatten norms, King's
  imported hypercontractivity theorem, complex response lemma, root-fidelity
  lemma, and nonidentity prior conditioning.
- science/coherent_memory.md: full coherent hybrid, classical histories, mixed
  inputs, inactive halt branches, late-index testing, and the finite lower bound.
- science/fresh_experiments.md: exact coefficient-matrix likelihood reduction,
  fixed-sign transcript mixture, classical adaptivity, and quadratic accuracy cost.
- science/partial_bell.md: physical probes and measurements, exact usability
  probability, unbiased estimator, variance, simultaneous confidence and costs.
- science/correlation_detection.md: positive-spike one-bit promise, linear
  syndrome rank algorithm, direct testing lower bound, and known noise strength.
- science/weak_noise.md: known identity mixtures, absolute versus relative
  error, the fresh-experiment factor tau/epsilon^2, and the coherent frontier.
- science/no_reset_frontier.md: common weight-one attenuated-spike task,
  inherited restricted-label collision bound, stronger entropy obstruction,
  qualified physical side-width consequence and shared proof ownership.
- science/interpretation.md: physical meaning, growing sublinear support,
  the small-output consequence, examples, and consequential limits.
- references/RELATED_WORK.md and references/references.bib: imported ingredients,
  source versions, the closest results and the bounded novelty comparison.
- verification/README.md: reproducibility commands and what finite checks establish.
- figures/README.md: analytical resource-regime figure, exact formulas and parameters,
  pinned plotting dependencies, generator command and output asset.

Reading routes:
- For a concrete introduction: learning/WORKED_EXAMPLE.md, then the milestone
  map; use learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md for the textbook-to-project translation.
- For the physical story: model -> interpretation -> correlation_detection.
- To reconstruct the converse: model -> weighted_bounds -> coherent_memory.
- To inspect the stronger fresh rate: weighted_bounds -> fresh_experiments.
- To implement the upper construction: partial_bell -> correlation_detection.
- To understand weak noise: weak_noise, keeping absolute and relative accuracy distinct.
- To compare fixed initial purity and width: no_reset_frontier, then the pinned
  sister entropy proof; distinguish the original reset-permitting model.
- To reproduce: read verification/README.md, then run verification/run_all.py.
- To regenerate the resource figure: read figures/README.md, then run
  python3 figures/generate_resource_regimes.py from the repository root.

Preserve these scientific distinctions when explaining or editing:
- Watrous is the only educational anchor. Research papers remain sources for
  attribution and imported proof ingredients; the book does not supply this
  project's weighted converse or replace its scientific proof homes.
- Count every unknown-channel invocation, including calls in coherent blocks.
- k includes ALL coherent registers outside the queried n-qubit register.
  Classical records are not uncounted quantum memory. A mixed input need not
  have a low-rank system reduction: use a pure-state decomposition within the
  actual system-reference space and convexity, not an extra accessible purification.
- The specific coefficient is unavailable during acquisition. A known single
  Pauli or a polynomial-sized known family does not have this lower bound.
- The coherent lower has an inverse-first-power accuracy factor; the stronger
  inverse-square prefactor belongs to the fresh-experiment model.
- A reusable classical record does not promise polynomial time to print an
  exponentially long coefficient list. The decision task outputs one bit.
- The hard prior is conditioned on nonidentity labels in the required weight range.
- The fixed sign in the fresh proof is averaged over whole executions, not anew
  at each channel call.
- The coherent hybrid has a null prefix independent of the hidden label.
  Do not apply the prior to a hidden-label-dependent posterior state.
- Weak unknown-channel mixtures may have globally correlated errors. The
  mixture strength tau is known, but no flag reveals its branch. At fixed
  relative error epsilon=alpha*tau, 0<alpha<1/3, the frontier is
  R+log(1/tau)=O(log n). At absolute error epsilon>=tau, the known midpoint
  1-tau needs no data. Ideal reference qubits and controls are assumed by the
  constructive upper bounds.
- Exact parity preservation is essential to the efficient rank detector.
  Its identity-mixture strength tau keeps the hidden eigenvalue at one; it is
  distinct from spike attenuation lambda=1/2 in the no-reset theorem.
- No-reset controls are unital on the whole initialized processor, with all
  records charged. Initial negentropy C in bits equals c only for the stated
  product clean/mixed initialization; collision purity is P=2^c there.
  At weight one, lambda=1/2 and worst-case error 1/3, C>=4n/3. The additional
  physical side-width necessity k_phys>=n/3 requires that every protected
  record is included in the n+k_phys qubit dimension. It does not follow for
  a k convention exempting extra classical registers. No matching linear
  resource protocol or complete no-reset frontier is established.
- The polynomial frontier is proved; exact exponential rates, the stronger
  Kim–Oh S85 formula, and optimal joint coherent accuracy–memory dependence are not.
- Primary attribution is part of the science. A finite check is not a universal
  theorem, a priority determination, or external peer review.
